items.title: EIP-8130：为初版简化
items.note: （chunter-cb）提交并合并：目标是高性能、能安全运行内存池的 AA 模型，内存池所需存储限于世界状态、可信验证器与标准地址的合约代码以及账户配置合约状态；EIP-8130：slot 推导留给最终合约（chunter-cb）合并。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: simplify for the initial EIP
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), submitted and merged: an AA model that is performant and can run a mempool safely, with mempool storage limited to world state, contract code for trusted verifiers and canonical addresses, and account config contract state; EIP-8130: slot derivations left to the final contract (chunter-cb), merged.
